countries.name: Russia
countries.heading: Workforce Supply for Russia
countries.body: We supply pre-vetted skilled and semi-skilled workers to businesses operating in Russia across construction, manufacturing, hospitality, welding, and technical trades. Our desk handles work permits, employer contracts, and local orientation on your behalf.
countries.visaNote: Work permits and employer contracts handled by our team

countries.name: Germany
countries.heading: Workforce Supply for Germany
countries.body: We support German employers hiring nurses, technicians, IT professionals, and tradespeople through the EU Blue Card and Skilled Worker Visa routes — including qualification recognition, language readiness (German A1/A2/B1), and visa documentation.
countries.visaNote: EU Blue Card & Skilled Worker Visa sponsorship support

countries.name: Poland
countries.heading: Workforce Supply for Poland
countries.body: As an EU manufacturing and logistics hub, Poland has strong demand for warehouse, factory, and technical workforce. We manage Type D work visa and EU work permit documentation for client companies hiring into Poland.
countries.visaNote: Type D work visa & EU work permit support

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.heading: Workforce Supply for the United Kingdom
countries.body: We supply care workers, construction tradespeople, and warehouse staff to UK employers under the Skilled Worker and Health and Care Worker visa routes, managing sponsorship documentation, right-to-work checks, and pre-deployment readiness.
countries.visaNote: Skilled Worker visa & Health and Care Worker visa sponsorship support

countries.name: Portugal
countries.heading: Workforce Supply for Portugal
countries.body: We supply agriculture, hospitality, and construction workforce to Portuguese employers under the D3 work visa and EU work permit routes, handling documentation, contract processing, and pre-deployment orientation on your behalf.
countries.visaNote: D3 work visa & EU work permit support

countries.name: Romania
countries.heading: Workforce Supply for Romania
countries.body: We supply manufacturing, warehouse, and construction workforce to employers across Romania, managing EU work permit and long-stay visa documentation for client companies scaling up production and logistics operations.
countries.visaNote: EU work permit & long-stay visa support

countries.name: Czech Republic
countries.heading: Workforce Supply for the Czech Republic
countries.body: We supply manufacturing, warehouse, and automotive-sector workforce to Czech employers, managing Employee Card and EU work permit documentation for client companies across the country's manufacturing and logistics hubs.
countries.visaNote: Employee Card & EU work permit support

countries.name: UAE
countries.heading: Workforce Supply for the UAE
countries.body: We supply construction, facilities management, and hospitality workforce to businesses across the UAE, along with MEP technicians and IT support staff. Our team manages employment visa sponsorship, labor card processing, and Emiratisation-compliant documentation.
countries.visaNote: Employment visa & labor card sponsorship handled by our team

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.heading: Workforce Supply for Saudi Arabia
countries.body: Vision 2030's infrastructure and construction boom has driven strong demand for skilled and semi-skilled labor across Saudi Arabia. We handle sourcing, Iqama sponsorship, and work visa documentation for client companies scaling up project workforce.

countries.name: Qatar
countries.heading: Workforce Supply for Qatar
countries.body: We supply construction, hospitality, and facilities management workforce for ongoing infrastructure and maintenance projects across Qatar, with full work visa sponsorship handled on your behalf.
countries.visaNote: Qatar work visa & sponsorship handled by our team

countries.name: Israel
countries.heading: Workforce Supply for Israel
countries.body: We supply construction and caregiving workforce to Israeli employers under the B/1 work visa route, managing candidate screening, documentation, and pre-deployment orientation.

countries.name: Japan
countries.heading: Workforce Supply for Japan
countries.body: We help employers hire under the Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) and Technical Intern Training Program (TITP) visa categories, and support Engineer/Specialist visa sponsorship for technical roles. Our team manages candidate skill testing, Japanese language readiness (JLPT/JFT), and full employer-side coordination.
countries.visaNote: SSW, TITP & Engineer/Specialist visa sponsorship support
